steps.name: Multi-channel capture and extraction
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Invoices from all channels are captured and extracted into a structured validated record in one automated pass, with clerk review only on low-confidence extractions.
inputs: Vendor invoice (email PDF, EDI, supplier portal or paper)

steps.name: Automated three-way match
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. The extracted invoice is matched against purchase order and goods receipt data automatically, within tolerance, producing a clean match or an exception.

steps.name: Exception review and resolution
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Only exceptions reach an analyst, who resolves them against variance detail and source documents.

steps.name: Risk-based approval
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. This is the deliberate defect: approval is folded into the accounting team, so the same actor both authorises the invoice and posts it. VIP-R-06 must fail.

steps.name: Automated GL coding and posting
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Approved invoices are coded from vendor and PO defaults and posted to the ledger and subledger, with the accountant reviewing only exceptions.

steps.name: Payment run scheduling and execution
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Posted invoices are scheduled into payment runs against terms and cash position; the payment file is transmitted and confirmed.

steps.name: Continuous reconciliation and close
steps.description: SMOKE FIXTURE. Bank confirmations, subledger and vendor statements reconcile continuously through the period rather than only at close.

disposition_mapping.rationale: SMOKE FIXTURE. Intake is merged with extraction into TS-01; channel handling becomes part of one capture step.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Extraction and validation are merged with intake into TS-01.
SMOKE FIXTURE. The three-way match remains a distinct step but is performed automatically within tolerance rather than by an analyst.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Exception handling is narrowed to genuine exceptions surfaced by TS-02.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Approval survives but is reassigned to the AP accountant, the same actor who performs the posting.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Coding is derived automatically, with the accountant retaining ownership of the posting.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Payment scheduling and execution carry over substantially unchanged.
SMOKE FIXTURE. Reconciliation moves from a period-end exercise to a continuous one.
